waivers.justification: User decision 2026-10-26 (PR #330), re-issued WITHOUT run_id (original: user decision 2026-10-25, PR #328, pinned to RUN_2026-10-25_08-28-45). The driver u_cpu_pll_sub.u_ref_cm.u_mux is a hand-instantiated mux2_4 (sky130_clkcells_stub) driving the hand-instantiated buf_16 root buffer u_root_buf: a name that survives re-synthesis, hence driver.stable=true (the loader rejects a stable flag on a tool-generated name). Clock net u_cpu_pll_sub.u_ref_cm.mux_clk is in the CTS clock-net set and carries 7 antenna diodes inserted after the cap repair stage; neither the pre-route nor the post-GRT cap-repair margin reaches it (GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_CAP_PCT 30 -> 40, RUN_2026-10-25_15-59-23, left it at 0.379-0.418 pF against the 0.3397 pF limit). Measured: RUN_2026-10-25_08-28-45 min_ss 0.3985, nom_ss 0.4210, max_ss 0.4356 pF; RUN_2026-10-26_09-59-03 (scan inserted) min_ss 0.3659, nom_ss 0.3811, max_ss 0.3912 pF (+8 to +15 percent over the limit). Only the three ss corners violate. The 0.45 pF ceiling is unchanged, so a regression above the baseline measurement still fails.

User decision 2026-10-26 (PR #330), supersedes the 2026-10-25 entry (ceiling 0.35, max_ss only). Write-data net u_sram.mb_din0_m[22] from the MBIST collar mux into the SRAM macro pin din0[22]. Measured in RUN_2026-10-26_09-59-03 (scan inserted): max_ss 0.3617 pF against the 0.3388 pF limit (+6.8 percent), nom_ss 0.3395 pF against 0.3388 (+0.2 percent); previously (RUN_2026-10-25_08-28-45) max_ss 0.3460 only. Ceiling 0.37 pF (user decision) = +2.3 percent above the measurement, so a regression fails. Keyed on the load macro pin, not on the synthesis-generated driver. See the 2026-10-25 note: the 40 percent over-repair run was not shipped.
